name: Lupita Nyong'o
summary: Lupita Nyong'o is an actor and author whose work has expanded representation in global film and children's literature.

facts.text: Nyong'o won the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her role in 12 Years a Slave.
facts.context: Her career highlights craft, persistence, and the importance of whose stories are allowed to reach global audiences.
facts.sourceTitle: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences: 2014 Oscars
